bio.intro: I am a Ph.D. candidate in political science studying how citizens form beliefs and attitudes about AI, and how this impacts their political behavior and preferences for government policies. My research sits at the intersection of political behavior, public opinion, political economy, and computational social science, combining experimental methods with computational modeling.
